summary: Nebius is one of the fastest-growing AI clouds: Q2 2026 revenue rose about 454% to roughly $582M with a 41% adjusted EBITDA margin, and it reaffirmed $3.0-3.4B 2026 revenue and $7-9B exit ARR. After a 25% drop in the week to Oct 16 the stock sits near the low end of its 13-week range, and our fair-value range of $135-240 (mid $185) brackets the price, so it screens as fairly valued with about 15% upside to the mid-point. The bull case rests on sold-out capacity and rising GPU pricing; the bear case is $20-25B of 2026 capex funded partly by convertibles and equity, plus very high implied volatility (~100%). Neutral, sized small, with a better entry near the $145-150 support zone.

valuation.method: Triangulated: (a) peers: CoreWeave at ~2.2x forward sales and 5% adj. op margin; Nebius deserves a premium for net-cash-like balance sheet and ~40% EBITDA margins; 4-6x 2027E sales of ~$8B (exit ARR mid-point) gives EV $32-48B. (b) Earnings power: 2027E EBITDA ~$3.2B (40% of $8B) at 12-18x = EV $38-58B. (c) Analyst targets: mean ~$270-284, range $84-410, recent Piper Sandler cut to $185. Per-share on ~272M shares and roughly flat net debt.
